categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in emergency response equipment, focusing on emergency transportation engineering equipment, emergency rescue equipment, emergency warning equipment, and emergency services. Its main product lines include waterway, land, railway, and aviation emergency transportation equipment, as well as flood control and rescue equipment. The company serves military, government disaster relief, and large engineering enterprises with customized products and solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in modular design, intelligent control, unmanned operation, and lightweight materials for emergency bridges and transportation platforms. It has proprietary technologies in powered pontoon bridges, mechanized bridges, and special heavy-duty transport platforms. Production follows lean and flexible manufacturing principles with standardized, process-driven, and visualized operations, supported by integrated project management and information systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military units, government agencies responsible for disaster relief, and large engineering companies. The company also serves international markets, exporting to over 50 countries including Pakistan, Thailand, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Peru, and is a qualified supplier for United Nations emergency procurement. The markets served span emergency transportation, flood control, firefighting, and emergency training sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Wuhan and Chibi, and marketing centers in Beijing. It has established four regional international centers to cover markets along the Belt and Road countries. Overseas operations include a subsidiary in Bolivia, although its overseas business there has been terminated. The company’s products have a global footprint with exports to multiple continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the emergency equipment supply chain, focusing on research, development, manufacturing, and direct sales of emergency transportation and rescue equipment. It sources raw materials like steel and heavy chassis from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and services directly to end users such as military and government clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing military core capabilities, expanding emergency rescue and warning equipment, and promoting intelligent, unmanned, and modular product development. The company emphasizes innovation through collaboration with research institutes and universities, focusing on breakthroughs in bridge design, lightweight materials, digitalization, and automation. It also aims to deepen international market penetration and improve production and management efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of emergency transportation engineering equipment and related products to government, military, and engineering customers. The company also earns income from leasing equipment and providing emergency training services. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and service completion, with customized contracts and staged payments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in emergency transportation equipment, especially in emergency bridges and mechanized transport platforms. It is recognized for high technical performance, mobility, and cost-effectiveness. While the industry is fragmented with many small and medium enterprises, the company is one of the few large-scale, high-end emergency equipment manufacturers with strong R&D capabilities and international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.16 billion, nearly doubling from the previous year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.64 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 3.75 billion with a slight decrease from the prior year. The company’s revenue and profit growth reflect a significant recovery and improved operational efficiency after previous losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high technical performance, modular and flexible design, and strong mobility of its emergency transportation equipment. Its products have proven effectiveness in major natural disaster rescues and military operations, earning a reputation as reliable and innovative solutions. The integration of intelligent, unmanned, and lightweight technologies differentiates its offerings, supported by strong after-sales service and customization capabilities.
